title: Neutron movie of coffee making
summary: A short film made with cold neutron imaging at the Paul Scherrer Institut showing a moka pot brewing coffee, sped up four times. The neutron beam makes the water and steam inside the pot visible.
why: Recommended in moka pot threads as the best way to see how the pot works from the inside.

quote.text: There's also a fantastic Youtube video in a neutron beam facility of a Moka pot
